details:
ExoNova — Space Mission Design Simulator

ExoNova is an interactive educational space mission simulator created for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It helps students and space enthusiasts explore aerospace engineering through hands-on experimentation.

How does it work?

Players build their own spacecraft in a 2D construction system, choosing components such as engines, fuel tanks, command modules, landing legs, and docking ports.

The game analyzes important engineering characteristics, including spacecraft mass, thrust, fuel capacity, estimated delta-v, and mission readiness.

Players can test their spacecraft in two challenges:

Moon Landing: Manage engine thrust, fuel consumption, and descent speed to attempt a safe lunar landing under simplified lunar gravity.

ISS Docking: Use maneuvering thrusters to approach a stationary-on-screen space station, reduce relative velocity, and align docking ports.

What makes ExoNova different?

Unlike a traditional arcade game, ExoNova connects spacecraft design with mission performance. A heavier spacecraft behaves differently from a lighter one, and limited fuel forces players to make engineering decisions.

After a mission, the player receives a performance score and feedback explaining what worked, what failed, and how to improve the spacecraft.

Educational impact

ExoNova introduces students to concepts such as thrust, mass, acceleration, fuel management, lunar gravity, and relative motion.

The project aims to make STEM education more accessible by allowing players to learn through experimentation rather than memorization.

Technologies and methodology

ExoNova was developed using Roblox Studio and Luau, with AI-assisted programming, debugging, interface development, and documentation.

The game uses simplified 2D physics inspired by aerospace engineering principles and educational resources from NASA.

The simulations are intended for learning and do not represent professional-grade spacecraft flight predictions.

Future development

Planned improvements include more advanced spacecraft construction, additional missions, navigation tools, and multiplayer collaboration.

Playable game: https://www.roblox.com/games/83070957144858
